messages.subject: sem with covariance matrix
parts:
i'm using sem(model, sample.cov = m, sample.nobs = 803) with 3 exogenous observed variables, 4 other observed variables, and no latent variables.  i got an unexpected error message:

Error in lavSampleStatsFromMoments(sample.cov = sample.cov, sample.mean = sample.mean,  : 

  lavaan ERROR: rownames of covariance matrix do not match the model!

  found: EarlyOn COMT Schizo Psysym Conduct Chpsyq GenxEnv

  expected: Conduct Chpsyq Schizo Psysym Earlyon COMT GenxEnv


can anyone suggest why this error?  Earlyon, COMT and GenxEnv are the 3 exogenous obs vars.  am i supposed to order the rows with the endogenous variables first?  thanks.
ewart

  found: EarlyOn COMT Schizo Psysym Conduct Chpsyq GenxEnv

  expected: Conduct Chpsyq Schizo Psysym Earlyon COMT GenxEnv

ewart

It doesn't matter what the order of variables in the matrix is, but the order of column names should match the order of row names by definition (covariance matrices are symmetric).  Print the row and column names to verify whether they truly mismatch

rownames(m)
colnames(m)

If they do not match, you should reconstruct your covariance matrix.  I have no idea how the names would not match to begin with.  You could set them equal to each other:

rownames(m) <- colnames(m)

but I have no idea whether the row or column names are in the correct order (possibly neither are).

Terry

terry, many thanks for your suggestion, which led me to see a typo in my model statement.  i had mistyped 1 letter of 1 variable name as lowercase instead of uppercase!  that fixed the problem.  thanks much.
ewart
